types.description: S2C-H11L left-mounted auxiliary switch, 1 NO + 1 NC

document.title: ABB System pro M compact catalogue

modelingNotes: S2C-H11L is the exact left-mounted 1 NO + 1 NC accessory; breaker terminals and separately purchased accessories are excluded.

ABB German catalogue excerpt, printed 1/87-1/88, diagram 2CDC 092 099 F0007, manufacturer-authored distributor mirror: https://www.hiv-hoffmann.de/wp-content/uploads/abb-system_pro_m_compact-datenblatt.pdf. Visually verified 13-14 NO and 21-22 NC, mechanically coupled; no fixed electrical links.
Four passive contact terminal positions; application-dependent wiring, no universally required terminal. Contact metadata and mechanical coupling do not join nets.

Conditional switching ratings (German catalogue section 3.3): AC-14 1 A at 400 V / 2 A at 230 V; DC-12 1 A at 220 V / 1.5 A at 110 V; DC-13 2 A at 60 V / 4 A at 24 V. Free-air thermal current 10 A is not a universal switching rating.

Conditional short-circuit withstand 1000 A at 230 V AC with S201 K4; impulse withstand 4 kV (1.2/50 microseconds), overvoltage category III; maximum tightening torque 0.8 N m, up to 2 x 1.5 mm² conductors.

2014 catalogue minimum operation: 10 mA at 12 V or 5 mA at 24 V. Undated German table specifies minimum 24 V AC/DC and 0.12 VA, with 5 mA AC-12/DC-12 under clean indoor conditions. No assigned voltage or scalar terminal rating is asserted.

connectionCoverage.notes: All four external contact terminals verified in ABB S2C-H11L diagram 2CDC 092 099 F0007 and InSite manual page 20. Two mechanically coupled, electrically separate contact paths; no supply, PE, shield or communication connection for this accessory. Breaker and enclosure connections excluded.
